2. ABL Consent delivery deadline extension to December 6, 2021  
3. Underlying Warrants issuance deadline extension to December 7, 2021

The memo also appropriately identifies the borrower (Team, Inc.) and all three lenders (the Corre funds), and notes the PIK Interest structure that was referenced in the document. All material terms present in the source document have been captured in the memo.
